a.text: Never have I heard your so highly excellent son so magnificent and incomparable as yesterday in Meyerbeer's immortal work, although he is always the first tenor of the present day. My joy was doubled when I caught sight of his so highly revered and likewise incomparable father among the audience, and told myself what he must be feeling at that moment!

b.text: Never have I heard your so most excellent son as gloriously and incomparably as yesterday in Meyerbeer's immortal work, although he is always the foremost tenor of the present day. My joy was doubled when I caught sight of his so highly honoured and likewise incomparable father among the listeners, and told myself what he must be feeling there!

a.text: Yet to my late, great friend, alas, the good fortune was not granted to hear his Raoul thus!

b.text: But my departed great friend, alas, was not granted the good fortune of hearing his Raoul sung in this way!

a.text: Your faithfully devoted Carl Kaskel, on 30th June 1864

b.text: Your faithfully devoted, on the 30th of June, Carl Kaskel, 1864
